profile.headline: Graphic Designer/Web Developer at BubbleUp
profile.summary:
I am a recent graduate of Indiana University.
 
I created my major, Cultural Design, through the Individualized Major Program at Indiana University.
 
My area of focus is in Graphic Design, Web Design, Marketing and African Studies.
 
I enjoy combining different forms of media to create unique visual experiences.
 
My experience is mostly in graphic design, social media management and marketing, but I also have experience in event planning, web design and HCI design.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description: Create a variety of print and online advertisements to promote events and campaigns at the IMU. Develop an online presence using social media.

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description: Communicate with clients, designers and sales representatives to create effective and unique advertisement solutions. Promote in-house campaigns and contest. Plan and organize large-scale events. Train and manage staff members.

positions.title: Creative Manager
positions.description: Design print and online advertisements for regional/national clients with a paper circulation of 15,000 per day. Create posters, ads and branding for in-house promotions and campaign projects. Manage a staff of eight designers.

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description: Create print, web and marketing materials for clients at a national level.
